newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia, PNG open routes to new airlines.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia, PNG open routes to new airlines.

text.p: Australia and Papua New Guinea have opened air routes between the two countries to new carriers, Australian Transport Minister John Sharp said on Tuesday.
Sharp said the new arrangements would allow flights by airlines other than Air Niugini and Qantas Airways Ltd and would almost double capacity.
The changes also allowed services to more airports, Sharp said.

"Subject to government approvals, opportunities are now available for Australian and PNG regional carriers to develop niche markets from points such as Darwin, Cairns and Tonwnsville to Port Moresby and other points in PNG," Sharp said in a statement.
Capacity would almost double over the next two years to the equivalent of daily Boeing 747 flights.
"The new arrangements have the potential to boost growth in the market, which has been virtually stagnant over the last three years," Sharp said.
